issues.reason: "current" fails the predication test (*"the warden is current") and is a relational / rank adjective, which the instruction set says is "never exposed as a modifier genus" (the assistant_secretary case, which keeps genus secretary only) and which falls outside the three licensed exposure categories, so (Inheritance current_warden current) is an unlicensed atom.

gaps_confirmed: no stated precedence between the mechanical casing rule ("the name is exactly its capitalized run of words") and the proper-noun-premodifier rule ("the head never joins the Name string") when the common-noun head of an office title is itself capitalized — "the current Cauldron Hall Warden"
defect_summary: Compliant form drops (Inheritance current_warden current) and keeps (Member hesper current_warden) plus the head genus (Inheritance current_warden warden), the rank modifier staying unexposed inside the fused symbol exactly as assistant_secretary keeps genus secretary only.
notes: The rest follows the Northgate-spokesman pattern faithfully — cauldron_hall as a name with its in-name kind atom (Member cauldron_hall hall), the head phrase parsed on its own and predicated of hesper by Member, and the opaque Possession linking her to the named entity.
